review: Let me put it this way. I run the English ministry inside a Korean-speaking church of six hundred. My parents' generation worships in Korean, my hundred and forty worship in English, and I stand in the middle of that every Sunday translating one to the other. I did not know you had a Korean album. "내게 임한 기름부으심" — I played it for my father, who is an elder, who corrects me privately and praises me publicly, and he listened to all of it and said nothing and then asked me to send it to him. That has not happened before. Five stars, and I would like a great deal more of this, and I would like it findable.
